title: Settings
providers_hint: Connections to model providers. Keys are stored locally and only ever shown masked.
models_hint: One entry per model you use. The context window and output cap bound the writer's budget.
roles_hint: Which model each agent role uses by default.
appearance_hint: These preferences apply to this browser and are stored locally.
no_providers_hint: Add the Demo provider to try every workflow without an API key, or connect a real provider.
name: Name
api_key_hint: Stored locally. Use env:NAME to read the key from an environment variable instead.
key_unchanged: leave empty to keep the stored key
delete_provider_body: The provider and its models are removed. Sessions that used them fail with a missing-model error.
no_models_hint: Add a model so the agent roles have something to run on.
fetch_failed: The provider did not list its models; type the model id instead.
delete_model_body: The model is removed from the settings. Existing sessions are not affected.
embeddings_hint: The local embedding model used for semantic search. Keyword search works without it.
embedding_model_hint: Changing the model rebuilds the vector index; keyword search is unaffected.
rebuild_hint: Re-embeds every document and retries failed items.
search_hint: The provider the researcher uses for web_search and web_fetch. The key is stored locally and never shown again in full.
search_api_key_hint: A literal key, or env:NAME to read it from the environment at call time.
search_base_url_hint: The SearXNG instance's address; JSON output must be enabled on it.
search_fetch_via_hint: The built-in fetcher is free, runs locally and keeps the SSRF guard; DeepSeek can extract pages it cannot.
search_max_results_hint: Default number of results per search (at most {{max}}).
search_test_empty: The provider answered with no results.
search_not_configured_hint: No provider is selected, so the researcher cannot search the web.
option.protocol_note: These options apply to {{protocol}} providers. Options that protocol cannot send are not shown.
option.reasoning_replay_hint: How the stored reasoning is sent back with an assistant turn. DeepSeek and Kimi reject tool calls in thinking mode without it.
option.max_tokens_field_hint: The request field that carries the output cap. Newer OpenAI models accept only max_completion_tokens.
option.send_parallel_tool_calls_hint: Whether the parallel-tool-calls flag is sent at all. Turn it off for a gateway that rejects the field.
option.stream_usage_hint: Ask the provider to include token usage in the stream. Turn it off for a gateway that rejects stream_options.
option.temperature_hint: Sampling temperature. Leave empty to omit the field; some models reject any value but their default.
option.extra_body_hint: Raw JSON merged into the request body last, so it wins over every field above. Use it for a gateway knob NekoWriter has no option for.
option.thinking_display_hint: Whether reasoning summaries are shown in the activity stream.
option.refusal_fallback_hint: Let Anthropic retry a refusal on its server-side fallback model.
option.eager_input_streaming_hint: Stream tool arguments as they are produced. Turn it off for a proxy that rejects the field.
option_mismatch: This model sets options its provider's protocol cannot send
option_mismatch_body: {{protocol}} providers cannot send {{options}}, so the model never receives them. Remove them, or replace them with the option that protocol supports, then save.
option_cleared_body: Switching to {{protocol}} removed {{options}}, because that protocol cannot send them.
option_mismatch_confirm: Remove {{options}} from this model? A {{protocol}} provider cannot send them, so the model never receives them.
option_json_object: Enter a JSON object, for example {"key": "value"}.
option.cache_ttl_hint: How long the provider keeps the prompt prefix cached. Automatic resolves per session: 1 hour for conception, for a planner that pauses after the outline, and for a writer that pauses, otherwise 5 minutes.
effort.title: Thinking effort
effort.hint: Agent roles choose one of these levels. A role that chooses none uses the default.
effort.mock_note: The Demo provider takes no effort levels.
effort.error.invalid: A level must be 1-32 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '_' and '-'.
effort.error.duplicate: That level is already in the list.
effort.error.limit: A model can have at most {{max}} levels.
effort.ignored_title: Some levels cannot be sent by this protocol
effort.ignored_body: {{protocol}} cannot send {{levels}}. They stay on this model and will be ignored.
effort_mismatch_title: This model sets thinking-effort levels its provider's protocol cannot send
effort_mismatch_body: {{model}} stores {{levels}}, which {{protocol}} cannot send. They stay configured and will be ignored.
effort_mismatch_confirm: Remove {{levels}} from {{model}}? {{protocol}} cannot send them, and roles that choose them fall back.
effort_mismatch_fixed: The unsupported effort levels were removed.
role_effort_stale_hint_none: Sessions will use the provider default.
